Re: Meeting Request: USAID Administrator Samantha Power / Nick Clegg
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Erma R. Hernandez Wednesday, April 27,2022 at 11:57:21 AM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Amol Shalia
Cc: [opaque block] [contact omitted] Stina Trainor
Hi Amol,
Thanks for checking in. Nick will be staffed by the following:
Brian Rice, VP Public Policy, Executive Branch
athanie Gleicher. Director Public Policv. Misinformation and Election Inteari
ike Bradow. Public Policy Manager. Misinformation Polic
Please reach out if you need anything else, but the team looks forward to the conversation.
Thanks again,
Erma
From: Amol Shalia <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Wednesday, April 27, 2022 8:39:18 AM
To: Erma R. Hernandez < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Stina Trainor < [opaque block]
Subject: Re: Meeting Request: USAID Administrator Samantha Power / Nick Clegg
Hi Erma,
Looking forward to the meeting later today. I just wanted to follow up and see if Mr. Clegg planned on additional attendees
joining this meeting?
Best,
Amol
On Tue, Apr 26, 2022 at 3:48 PM Amol Shalia <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Erma,
I wanted to follow up on attendees for tomorrow's meeting. Please let me know if Mr. Clegg plans on inviting other staff
to join him.
Administrator Power
Isobel Coleman, Deputy Administrator for Policy and Programing
Adam Siegel, Special Advisor, Office of the Administrator
Johnny Walsh, Deputy Assistant Administrator, Bureau for Development, Democracy, and Innovation
Rob Berschinski, White House National Security Council staff
Best,
On Mon, Apr 25, 2022 at 5:24 PM Erma R. Hernandez [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Thanks so much for sending over. Please reach out if there is anything else I can help with ahead of the
call.
From: Amol Shalia <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Monday, April 25, 2022 2:21 PM
To: Erma R. Hernandez < [opaque block]
Cc: Stina Trainor < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Meeting Request: USAID Administrator Samantha Power / Nick Clegg

Thank you, Erma!
Webex link noted below.
Administrator Power / Nick Clegg
Hosted by Amol Shalia (USAID)
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
Best,
Amol
On Mon, Apr 25, 2022 at 4:56 PM Erma R. Hernandez ‹ [opaque block] [contact omitted]>wrote:
Yes, that works well. Please send the WebEx details when you have a moment, but thanks!
From: Amol Shalia <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Monday, April 25, 2022 9:23 AM
To: Erma R. Hernandez [opaque block]
Cc: Stina Trainor < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Meeting Request: USAID Administrator Samantha Power / Nick Cleg
Thank you!
That actually works for us too. Can we move the meeting UP to 2:15PM EST / 11:15AM PST on Wednesday?
Best,
Amol
On Mon, Apr 25, 2022 at 12:20 PM Erma R. Hernandez ‹ [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Amol,

Really sorry, but Nick has an engagement on Campus starting at 2:15 pm PST.
Nick is flexible between 9:00 1:00 pm PST/12:00 4:00 pm EST, if that helps at all. He is also free at
3:30 pm PST/6:30 pm EST.
Thanks,
Erma
From: Amol Shalia <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Monday, April 25, 2022 9:05 AM
To: Erma R. Hernandez ‹ [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Stina Trainor < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Meeting Request: USAID Administrator Samantha Power / Nick Clegg
Erma
If we can even push back 30 minutes that'd be helpful. If not, I'll try to keep our original time and make it work.
Best,
Amol
On Mon, Apr 25, 2022 at 11:59 AM Amol Shalia <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Erma,
I'll send a link soon. I wanted to ask if there was any flexibility on Nick's schedule? This is totally a "me"
problem and not a "vou" problem but I'm trvina to schedule a formal bilateral meetina on Wednesdav
afternoon. Is it at all possible to shift our meetina back one hour to 5:00PM EST / 2:00PM PST?
Best,
Amol
On Sun, Apr 24, 2022 at 9:48 PM Erma R. Hernandez [opaque block] [contact omitted]>wrote:
That would be great. Thank you!!

From: Amol Shalia <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Sunday, April 24,2022 6:46 PM
To: Erma R. Hernandez < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Stina Trainor < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; [contact omitted]
Subject: Re: Meeting Request: USAID Administrator Samantha Power / Nick Clegg
No worries! I can also provide a webex link if y'all think that'll be easier?
Best,
Amol
On Sun, Apr 24, 2022 at 9:37 PM Erma R. Hernandez- [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Amol,
Apologies for the delay here, but would it be possible to use another platform? We can't use
Google Meet on our work laptops, unless Nick uses his personal email address, and that adds
some complications.
I'm happy to send Zoom details if that's okay. Let us know.
Many thanks,
Erma
From: Erma R. Hernandez
Sent: Tuesday, April 19, 2022 3:26 PM
To: Amol Shalia <[contact omitted]>
Cc: [contact omitted]; Stina Trainor < [opaque block]
Subject: RE: Meeting Request: USAID Administrator Samantha Power / Nick Clegg
Thanks, Amol. That shouldn't be a problem, but l'll need to check with Nick's IT team to
ensure we can make that happen.
I'Il circle back within the next couple of days.
Thanks!

Erma
From: Amol Shalia <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Tuesday, April 19,2022 2:38 PM
To: Erma R. Hernandez < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: [contact omitted]; Stina Trainor < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Meeting Request: USAID Administrator Samantha Power / Nick Clega
Thanks so much!
30 minutes should be enough but I would strongly recommend adding at least a 15 minute buffer on the
back end in case things run long.
I will follow up about additional attendees. I suspect we may have 2-3 other people join the
Administrator. Let's settle the platform. Our preferred platform is Google Meet. I'm happy to share a link
and run a test with you at any time if it is a platform you're unfamiliar with. Do let me know.
Best,
Amol
On Tue, Apr 19, 2022 at 5:25 PM Erma R. Hernandez < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>wrote:
Hi Amol,
Let's go ahead and confirm next Wednesday, 4:00 pm EST/1:00 pm PST. I assume 30 mins
will suffice, but please let me know if we should allocate additional time.
Also, will any staff be joining on the Administrator's side? I want to ensure | flag to Nick and
team.
Many thanks again,
Erma
From: Amol Shalia <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Tuesday, April 19, 2022 11:36 AM
To: Erma R. Hernandez < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: [contact omitted]; Stina Trainor < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; NCadmin
[opaque block]
Suayect: Re: Meting Request: USAID Administralor Samantha Power / Nick Clegg

Absolutely, happy to hold.
Best,
Amol
On Tue, Apr 19, 2022 at 2:27 PM 'Erma R. Hernandez' via A/AID FO Scheduling <aaid-fo-
[contact omitted]> wrote:
Can we hold that time for now? I believe I can make that work. I'Il reach out by EOD.
Many thanks!
Erma
From: Amol Shalia <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Tuesday, April 19, 2022 11:05 AM
To: Erma R. Hernandez < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: [contact omitted]; Stina Trainor < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; NCadmin
[opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Meeting Request: USAID Administrator Samantha Power / Nick Clegg
What about the afternoon the day before, April 27. I can make any time after 4:00PM EST work.
Best,
Amol
On Tue, Apr 19, 2022 at 2:00 PM Erma R. Hernandez < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Apologies, but Nick will be meeting with our CEO at that time. Could we do 3:00pm
PST/6:00 pm EST, Thursday 4/28/?
Thanks,
Erma
From: Amol Shalia <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Tuesday, April 19, 2022 10:51 AM
To: Erma R. Hernandez < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: [contact omitted]; Stina Trainor < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; NCadmin
[opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Meeting Request: USAID Administrator Samantha Power / Nick Clegg

Hi Erma,
No need to apologize. The Administrator will be in a meeting at that time. Any way we can go
just an hour later for 5:30PM EST / 2:30PM PST?
Best,
Amol
On Mon, Apr 18, 2022 at 11:28 PM 'Erma R. Hernandez' via A/AID FO Scheduling <aaid-fo-
[contact omitted]> wrote:
Dear Amol,
Apologies for the delayed response. I was sorting through Nick's schedule for next week and I'm afraid
all 1 can offer for next is Thursday 4/28, 1:30 - 2:00 pm P74:30 - 5:00 pm ET.
If that doesn't work, can we look at Friday, April 29?
Many thanks,
Erma Hernandez
Executive Assistant to Nick Clegg
President, Global Affairs
[opaque block] [contact omitted]
[opaque block]
From: Amol Shalia <[contact omitted]>
Date: Friday, April 15, 2022 at 1:48 PM
To: NCadmin < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Stina Trainor < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>, A/AID FO Scheduling <aaid-fo-
[contact omitted]>
Subject: Meeting Request: USAID Administrator Samantha Power / Nick
Clegg
Good afternoon,
Administrator Power is hoping to meet with Mr. Clegg sometime in the next few weeks.
Would he be available for a virtual meeting sometime in the afternoon on Thursday, April 28?

Please let me know and have a lovely weekend.
Best,
--
Amol K. Shalia
Scheduler
Office of the Administrator
USAID
